build_monocular_encoder: build a CroCoDownstreamMonocularEncoder network for monocular downstream tasks using a custom head
build_binocular_encoder: build a CroCoDownstreamBinocular network for binocular downstream tasks with paired image encoding
extract_croco_args: extract CroCo model kwargs from a checkpoint file using croco_args_from_ckpt
encode_image_pairs: encode a pair of images efficiently by concatenating them along the batch dimension
run_monocular_forward: run forward pass on a single image through the monocular encoder and custom head
